text.arabic_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

words.gloss_range: second-person plural command to eat in a reward-hospitality frame, with no overt food object
words.root_gloss_range: local imperative selects permitted eating and provision; harsher consumption or wrongful-devouring ranges are only contrastive background here
words.prose: {{ar:كُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:kulū}}) opens the ayah as direct hospitality: the righteous are addressed as participants, not merely described as figures in a garden. Its plural imperative ending carries the addressees without an overt subject and matches the later drinking command, making one shared group receive the whole invitation. The verb also leaves the eaten object unnamed, so the command remains open to the bounty already pictured rather than narrowing the reward to one item. Because the phrase belongs to the recurring reward formula with {{ar:ٱشْرَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:ishrabū}}) and {{ar:هَنِيٓـًٔۢا}} ({{tr:hanīʾan}}) (52:19; 77:43), the broader consumption range is narrowed toward legitimate, wholesome enjoyment, while the ayah boundary turns the near fruit of 69:23 into usable gift.

topics.headline: imperative makes reward a direct welcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden scene turns into a spoken welcome that permits action now.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:كُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:kulū}}) as a 2mp imperative clause, and the reward setting licenses command-as-welcome rather than command-as-burden.

topics.headline: plural morphology keeps one addressed group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the same plural addressees are carried by morphology across the food-and-drink pair.
topics.reason: The implicit-subject evidence recovers 2mp addressees from the imperative ending, and coordination links the first command to the second.

topics.headline: no object keeps the bounty open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the eating is not limited to a named food item; the nearby bounty supplies the field without being itemized.
topics.reason: The verb frame marks no overt object, and the translation support warns against adding a food object where the surface keeps compression.

topics.headline: consumption range becomes safe provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears ordinary eating as granted provision, while harsher consume-devour branches remain contrastive and inactive.
topics.reason: The local reward speech and the following wholesome modifier select permitted eating; broader negative consumption senses cannot govern the local imperative.

topics.headline: formula turns scene into invitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Quranic food-and-drink reward formula and sees the previous garden description become usable invitation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels (52:19; 77:43), and attachment evidence confirms the local coordinated command pair.

topics.headline: opening beat starts the retrospective arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels present enjoyment arrive first, before the ayah discloses its prior cause and past time-frame.
topics.reason: The first imperative begins the ayah's command beat, followed by the causal and temporal material.

topics.headline: minor sound-shape observation
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The acoustic note is decorative once the opening imperative and formula topics already preserve the command's reader-facing movement.
topics.reason: No independent lexical or structural payoff survives beyond the retained opening-beat topics.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two imperatives into one food-and-drink invitation without sequencing
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that turns the opening command into a balanced pair. It coordinates {{ar:ٱشْرَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:ishrabū}}) with {{ar:كُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:kulū}}), so drinking is neither a delayed consequence nor a swallowed part of eating; both forms of intake are jointly available. The minimal particle keeps the beat compact, and its attachment to the hamzat-wasl verb lets the sound-flow match the syntax: one welcome, two complete commands, then one shared wholesome qualifier.

topics.headline: coordination makes two equal imperatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that food and drink are jointly offered without making one the consequence of the other.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a coordinating conjunction, and attachment evidence links the two imperative clauses.

topics.headline: small particle pivots the opening beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how one letter visibly doubles the hospitality frame while keeping each command complete.
topics.reason: The particle stands between two complete command units and creates the local pivot into the second intake act.

topics.headline: liaison audibly joins the second command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector flow into the second imperative in a way that reinforces its joining function.
topics.reason: The phonetic note is modest but tied to the same coordination already established by grammar.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural command to drink, coordinated with eating and left without an overt beverage object
words.root_gloss_range: literal drinking is locally selected; absorption, saturation, watering-place, and allotted-share images remain bounded semantic pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱشْرَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:ishrabū}}) completes the opening food-and-drink merism. It repeats the 2mp imperative force of {{ar:كُلُوا۟}} ({{tr:kulū}}), keeps the same addressed group, and names the second form of intake without specifying a beverage. That objectless command makes drink as unrestricted as the food, while the formulaic order moves from solid sustenance to liquid refreshment before {{ar:هَنِيٓـًٔۢا}} ({{tr:hanīʾan}}) qualifies both. That wholesome qualifier selects the beneficial pole of the drink register, away from test, thirst, or punishment. The wider root field can suggest absorption, prepared access, or allotted drink, but the Form I imperative keeps the addressees as active drinkers in a reward scene, not as passive objects of saturation.

topics.headline: second command sustains the same address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second command widens the same welcome rather than starting a new scene.
topics.reason: The word is a 2mp imperative coordinated with the first command, and the implicit-subject evidence keeps the addressees continuous.

topics.headline: no beverage object leaves access open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the drinks offered without itemization, so abundance is implied without narrowing the reward.
topics.reason: The verb frame marks no overt object for the drinking command, parallel to the first imperative.

topics.headline: absorption and provision images stay bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel drinking as full, prepared, granted intake, while the surface grammar remains literal active drinking.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I command, so derivative absorption and share images color the command but do not replace its literal drinking sense.

topics.headline: drinking completes the reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the second half of a conventional reward-consumption formula in the order food then drink.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the drink command to the eat-drink formula and the attachment evidence confirms it is the coordinated counterpart.

topics.headline: wholesome modifier selects the beneficial pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this drinking as safe reward-drinking, not as the root's test, thirst, or punishment register.
topics.reason: The drinking command is coordinated with eating and modified by the shared wholesome state.

topics.headline: plural suffix repeats the first command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the same plural command shape bind both acts under one welcome.
topics.reason: The imperative morphology and plural suffix repeat the first command's addressee marking.

topics.headline: minor phonetic texture
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The phonetic texture does not add a distinct lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained drink-command topics.
topics.reason: The observation is decorative once the formula, command, and semantic-range topics are retained.

words.gloss_range: accusative qualitative state over both eating and drinking: wholesome, pleasant, beneficial, and without harmful after-effect
words.root_gloss_range: benefit, pleasantness, freedom from harm, with gift and felicitation derivatives as bounded resonance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused causal preposition plus relative pronoun
relative pronoun governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:هَنِيٓـًٔۢا}} ({{tr:hanīʾan}}) lands after both imperatives and gathers them into one quality of enjoyment. Its accusative adjective form functions locally as a circumstantial state over eating and drinking, while alternative accusative explanations still preserve the same point: the quality belongs inside the consumption act, not to a separate object. The word does more than say pleasant; it marks the intake as beneficial and free of after-cost, so reward consumption carries no sickness, heaviness, depletion, or moral sting. Family images of gift and congratulation make that safe state feel ceremonially granted, while the boundary with the near fruit of 69:23 pairs effortless reach with harmless intake. Its rare distribution in the same reward-consumption formula (52:19; 77:43) and its marked sound shape give the quality special weight at the close of the opening beat.

topics.headline: accusative state qualifies both commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wholesomeness covers the entire eating-and-drinking event, not only one item or one verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as a circumstantial qualifier of both coordinated imperatives.

topics.headline: other accusative parses keep quality internal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that even alternate parses keep the wholesome quality tied to the act rather than creating a new reward object.
topics.reason: The local attachment favors circumstantial function, so verbal-noun or intensive readings are retained only as compatible ways of keeping the quality internal to consumption.

topics.headline: pleasure without adverse effect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward as safe enjoyment, with normal after-costs of consumption removed.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports beneficial, agreeable, harm-free enjoyment, and the local grammar applies it to the consumption pair.

topics.headline: gift and congratulation color the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the safe enjoyment as ceremonially granted, while the surface still names a wholesome state.
topics.reason: Derivative gift and felicitation images can color the reward address but cannot replace the adjective's local wholesome-state function.

topics.headline: rare adjective marks reward consumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare adjectival form is reserved for this kind of safe reward-consumption quality.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root/form as low-occurrence and adjectival, supporting a constrained quality-state reading.

topics.headline: delayed modifier closes the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits until after both commands to learn that the whole intake is consequence-free.
topics.reason: The word follows both commands and is recitationally marked at the point where the quality is named.

topics.headline: near fruit becomes harmless intake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous nearness of fruit completed by the removal of harm after consumption.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the prior fruit scene with the local harmless-consumption state.

words.gloss_range: proclitic preposition governing the relative phrase as the causal or recompense ground for the whole invitation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused causal preposition plus relative pronoun
relative pronoun governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the hinge from present enjoyment to explanation. As a bound preposition on {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}), it opens {{ar:بِمَآ}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}), the compact phrase that grounds both imperatives in what the addressees sent ahead. Its force can be causal and recompense-like at once: the reward is because of prior action and is presented in return for it, without needing a new finite connector. Because the phrase comes after the command beat, the invitation lands first, then the ayah pulls it backward into a moral and temporal basis.

topics.headline: preposition grounds both imperatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reason for reward scopes over eating and drinking together, not only the nearest word.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links {{ar:بِمَآ}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}) to both imperatives and carries the causal phrase through the explanation.

topics.headline: cause and recompense remain jointly live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears prior deeds both as the reason for the welcome and as the recompense frame of the welcome.
topics.reason: Both causal and exchange readings fit the local prepositional phrase; neither is contradicted by the grammar.

topics.headline: bound form compresses cause and content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the causal gateway compressed into one fused phrase rather than expanded into a separate explanatory sentence.
topics.reason: The preposition is proclitic on the relative pronoun, forming the gateway phrase {{ar:بِمَآ}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}).

topics.headline: after-command placement turns reward backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first receives the present welcome, then learns that it is anchored in prior deeds and prior time.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the command and opens the explanatory tail that reaches into the past-days phrase.

words.gloss_range: headless relative pronoun governed by the causal preposition and resolved by the following verb clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: headless relative object of the verb

words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) gives the causal phrase its open object: what the addressees sent ahead. It has no named antecedent before it, so the inventory of prior deeds is not itemized; the reference becomes specific only when {{ar:أَسْلَفْتُمْ}} ({{tr:aslaftum}}) arrives. Governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), the small relative pronoun carries the whole causal content of the reward, and the phrase can lean toward either the deeds themselves or the act of sending, while preserving the same link between prior action and present welcome.

topics.headline: unnamed antecedent keeps deeds inclusive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward's cause is real but not narrowed to a named list of deeds.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a relative pronoun, and the relative clause supplies the recoverable content without an overt antecedent noun.

topics.headline: pronoun routes meaning into the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for the following verb to learn what the pronoun contains.
topics.reason: The relative content is completed by the following verb clause.

topics.headline: relative pronoun carries the causal object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a small pronoun bear the whole explanation: because of what was sent ahead.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) as governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and as object within the relative clause.

topics.headline: thing-sent and act-sent construals remain bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear both what was sent and the sending act as the basis, while the local parse remains relative.
topics.reason: The primary QAC tag is relative pronoun, so a source-like causal leaning is retained only as a compatible construal of {{ar:بِمَآ}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}).

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect: you caused something to go ahead, with the object held open by the preceding relative pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: preceding, passing, sending ahead, advance payment or prior deposit; local reward frame selects active prior dispatch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prior-dispatch verb governed by the final temporal phrase
causal phrase before the temporal frame
headless relative object of the verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَسْلَفْتُمْ}} ({{tr:aslaftum}}) is the hinge verb of the explanation. Its perfect aspect places the action before the present command, and its Form IV shape makes the addressees active agents who caused something to go ahead rather than people merely caught in passing time. The thing sent remains open through {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}), but the 2mp ending ties the present recipients to their own prior dispatch. The root's advance-payment and predecessor imagery gives the deeds a forward-deposit shape, while the local frame narrows that image away from a crude commercial transaction and toward recompense: what went ahead is now met by welcome. The same prior-action formula can expose blame elsewhere, but here the hospitality frame makes it positive, and the forward-dispatch verb already points toward the closing past-days phrase.

topics.headline: perfect aspect places action before reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present enjoyment is explained by completed prior action.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect, contrasting with the preceding imperatives.

topics.headline: Form IV makes agents send ahead
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees as agents who dispatched deeds forward, not as passive occupants of the past.
topics.reason: The local form is Form IV perfect with explicit transitive force in the relative clause.

topics.headline: object remains inclusive through the relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior record is recoverable but not reduced to an itemized list.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the object within the verb clause while the surface leaves the inventory unnamed.

topics.headline: suffix ties recipients to their deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people commanded to enjoy as the same people grammatically marked as prior agents.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix in the perfect verb matches the imperative addressees.

topics.headline: advance-deposit image gives recompense weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels prior deeds as something advanced before settlement, while the ayah does not reduce paradise to a market price.
topics.reason: Advance-payment and foretaste images are lexically coherent but must be bounded by the causal reward frame rather than overmade into commercial doctrine.

topics.headline: deeds go ahead of their agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines the deeds preceding the people into the future reward scene.
topics.reason: The local reward context selects active advance-sending from the root's broader preceding and passing range.

topics.headline: prior-action formula can be positive here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior-action formula is morally colored by context; here it explains reward, not exposure or blame.
topics.reason: Distributional rows show both positive and negative prior-action contexts; the local command and wholesome reward frame assign positive polarity.

topics.headline: verb makes the explanation move
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's reward logic turn on a verb of prior dispatch inside the causal phrase.
topics.reason: The verb is the core of the relative clause governed by the causal preposition.

topics.headline: advance verb anticipates the final time-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the forward-dispatch verb already preparing the closing phrase about the days left behind.
topics.reason: The verb is followed by the temporal phrase and is uncommon enough to make the deed-to-reward link pointed.

topics.headline: minor sound-shape observation
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The clipped sound observation adds no separate reader-facing payoff after the Form IV dispatch and causal-hinge topics.
topics.reason: The phonetic point is decorative rather than necessary for lexical review.

words.gloss_range: independent preposition marking the temporal container in which the prior sending occurred

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal phrase before the temporal frame

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) opens the final temporal frame. It attaches to {{ar:أَسْلَفْتُمْ}} ({{tr:aslaftum}}) and governs {{ar:ٱلْأَيَّامِ}} ({{tr:al-ayyāmi}}), locating the prior dispatch inside days now described as gone. The governed noun selects a temporal reading rather than physical place, but the containment logic remains useful: the deeds were placed within a bounded era. As an independent preposition after the fused {{ar:بِمَآ}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}), it gives the closing time-frame its own beat, shifting the reader from what was sent ahead to where, in time, it was sent.

topics.headline: preposition governs the past-days frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prior deeds are located inside a bounded past time-frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the preposition as governing the temporal noun phrase after the prior-dispatch verb.

topics.headline: locative container logic becomes time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the past days as an enclosing domain, while the governed noun blocks a physical-place reading.
topics.reason: The noun {{ar:ٱلْأَيَّامِ}} ({{tr:al-ayyāmi}}) selects temporal scope, so containment is retained as construal rather than physical location.

topics.headline: independent preposition opens the closing beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the explanation pivot from the sent-ahead deed to the time-container that seals it.
topics.reason: The preposition is a separate word after the verb, opening the final temporal phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive plural days functioning as the temporal domain of prior action
words.root_gloss_range: day, time, period, era, and significant-event fields; local plural definite phrase narrows this to known bygone worldly intervals
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَيَّامِ}} ({{tr:al-ayyāmi}}) gives the prior dispatch a named temporal domain. Grammatically it is genitive under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so it is the container in which {{ar:أَسْلَفْتُمْ}} ({{tr:aslaftum}}) occurred, not the object sent ahead. Its definite plural shape makes the past multiple and identifiable: the known worldly intervals in which the deeds were done. The broader day-field can include eras and significant events, but here that range narrows to lived past periods, set against Surah 69's judgment-day register (69:15-18; 69:35). The noun also prepares the final adjective, because the days are not merely counted; they are about to be characterized as gone or emptied.

topics.headline: governed noun becomes time-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the days frame when the deeds happened; they are not themselves what was sent ahead.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the preposition, and attachment evidence makes it the temporal complement of the verb.

topics.headline: definite plural makes the past known and multiple
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees not vague time but known, multiple intervals of worldly life.
topics.reason: The noun is definite plural and functions as a temporal domain.

topics.headline: noun gives the final adjective its domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final adjective attach specifically to the days, making their quality decisive for the ayah's close.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following word as an adjective modifying this noun.

topics.headline: event-day range becomes lived past intervals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the past as more than calendar units, while event or battle senses stay bounded by the local phrase.
topics.reason: The plural day-field can include periods and significant events, but the local prepositional phrase selects the addressees' bygone worldly interval.

topics.headline: plural spreads deeds across a life-period
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior action distributed across repeated intervals rather than compressed into a single moment.
topics.reason: The plural form and delayed final phrase allow the record to span multiple past intervals.

topics.headline: plural past days contrast the surah's judgment day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees plural past days set against the surah's larger day-of-judgment movement.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite Surah 69 judgment-time occurrences (69:15-18; 69:35), and the local plural shifts that temporal thread backward.

topics.headline: days pair with emptiedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the present eating explained by a past now viewed retrospectively as elapsed.
topics.reason: The noun is paired locally with the following adjective and comes after the eating command as its past cause.

topics.headline: significant-days field narrows locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a field of divinely significant periods, while the local phrase names the addressees' bygone worldly days.
topics.reason: The broader significant-days field is valid background, but local definiteness and adjective attachment constrain it to the past interval of prior action.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive feminine singular active-participle adjective modifying the days as gone, emptied, or vacated
words.root_gloss_range: passing away, becoming empty, vacancy, absence, and perishing; local adjective holds pastness and emptiedness together
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَالِيَةِ}} ({{tr:al-khāliyah}}) seals the ayah by defining what kind of days held the prior deeds. Its definiteness, genitive case, and adjective agreement lock it to {{ar:ٱلْأَيَّامِ}} ({{tr:al-ayyāmi}}), so the whole final phrase means within the days characterized as gone or emptied. Because the form is an active participle used adjectivally, elapsed time becomes a standing quality of the days rather than a narrated event. That rare participial choice transforms the common passing-away formula into a quality attached to days. The root holds pastness and emptiness together: the worldly interval is not simply earlier, but vacated like cleared space behind the present reward. The same-surah echo with vanished peoples (69:9) shifts the root from perished communities to emptied days, and the final position leaves the ayah resting on present welcome over a past that has cleared out. The extended -iyah cadence lets that recession be heard at the close.

topics.headline: agreement locks adjective to days
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees emptiedness as the defining quality of the specific days, not an incidental comment.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite genitive adjective modifying the definite days.

topics.headline: participle makes emptiedness a state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the days are described as bearing an emptied condition, not merely reported as having passed.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participle functioning adjectivally, and the profile marks this form as an adjective dependent.

topics.headline: past time becomes vacated space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines the former worldly time as cleared out behind the present reward.
topics.reason: The root range supports both pastness and emptiness, and the local adjective applies that range to days.

topics.headline: vacating derivatives intensify without governing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader gets a concrete cleared-space image for the past, while unused derivatives do not replace the local adjective.
topics.reason: Vacating and empty-land images are valid family pressure, but the local form remains the adjectival active participle.

topics.headline: feminine singular concord treats days collectively
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the plural days gathered into one collective temporal class for the final description.
topics.reason: The adjective's feminine singular form agrees with the nonhuman plural noun according to Arabic concord.

topics.headline: rare participle gives closure weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare participial form, not the common perfect formula, carries the final description of time.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks the local active participle as low-occurrence and adjectival.

topics.headline: day plus emptiedness forms closure phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final two-word phrase complete the move from reward to cause to elapsed time.
topics.reason: The adjective modifies the days and completes the closing temporal phrase.

topics.headline: root echo moves from vanished peoples to days
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root used for vanished peoples returns for vanished days, making time itself part of the surah's disappearance motif.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite the same-root echo with the earlier destruction register (69:9), now shifted into the closing time phrase.

topics.headline: final adjective bookends present reward with vanished past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end by contrasting the present welcome with the emptied worldly past behind it.
topics.reason: The word is the ayah's final adjective and completes the command-cause-time arc.

topics.headline: common passing formula becomes adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the common passing-away root logic transformed into a quality attached to days.
topics.reason: The row family contrasts many perfect-verb uses with the local adjectival participle, and the same-surah echo is concretely anchored (69:9).

topics.headline: final cadence matches semantic recession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close softly where the past is made to recede.
topics.reason: The sound note is tied to the final-position semantic closure and is retained as a minor candidate payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal construction linking the imperatives to what was advanced in the elapsed days.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eating is an allotted provision, drinking is an allotted water share, and wholesome ease is the form in which a prior advance is redeemed after a temporal interval.

activation_trace.role: The consumable-share image makes eating the redemption form of an allotted provision.
The allotted-water image gives drinking the form of receiving one's assigned share.
Easy wholesome benefit specifies that the redeemed provision carries no harmful remainder.
The advance-money or loan image supplies the deferred-transfer mechanism.
An open span of time supplies the interval across which the advance travels.
Passing away or elapsing marks the prior days as gone while their advance remains effective.

changed_reading.before: A pleasant banquet is granted because of earlier conduct.
changed_reading.after: Earlier conduct has been advanced across elapsed time and is now redeemed as an allotted, bodily, harmless provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adverbial wholesome ease governing eating and drinking, together with the past-day qualifier.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reward is not only possession of food and drink but their unobstructed assimilation: benefit permeates the recipient while the old advance closes without liability or anxious residue.

activation_trace.role: Permeating or being imbued turns drinking into complete inward assimilation.
Easy wholesome benefit makes the assimilation safe rather than merely pleasurable.
The loan image creates an exposure that can later be settled.
Being clear of liability supplies the release produced when the prior advance reaches settlement.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome means that the meal tastes pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome marks a whole-body and account-level safety: the provision enters without resistance and the prior exposure leaves no liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The advance verb stands between a meal command and the elapsed days.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of the advance root names food served before the meal, allowing the past life to function as an advance course and the present eating and drinking as completion of one meal stretched across time.

activation_trace.role: Food advanced before a meal supplies the two-course temporal analogy.
Literal food ingestion supplies the later course that completes the sequence.
Literal drinking completes the meal rather than standing outside the temporal analogy.
The open span of time stretches the two courses across distinct phases of existence.

changed_reading.before: Past deeds externally purchase a later meal.
changed_reading.after: Past action is the advance course of a single temporally extended meal whose completion is now eaten and drunk.

context_deltas.mechanism: The advance-provision baseline becomes an embodied audit: the record fixes judgment, the right side marks favorable realization, the account counts, and satisfaction follows. Eating is the material execution of that settlement.

activation_trace.role: The advance-money image remains the focus-side item awaiting settlement.
The consumable-share image makes the settlement materially edible.
A written fixing that obliges judgment supplies the enforceable record.
Blessing attached to the right side marks the handed record as favorable realization.
Counting and accounting provide the operation that resolves the advance.
Satisfaction rather than displeasure supplies the affective result of the favorable account.

structural_cues: The sequence immediately before the focus moves from a handed and publicly read record to anticipated account and satisfied life before issuing the eating command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, favorable handedness, account, and satisfaction; I infer that the causal phrase closes that audit in edible form. A live alternative is that the meal remains gracious reward rather than an exact wage.

changed_reading.before: The advance is repaid as provision in a broad metaphorical sense.
changed_reading.after: The meal is the bodily execution of a written, counted, and favorably settled account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior action behaves like cultivation whose yield has matured. The garden holds the crop, harvest time arrives, and the fruit is brought near so that eating is uptake of a grown return rather than receipt of an abstract payment.

activation_trace.role: Fruit or yield makes eating the terminal uptake of a productive cycle.
Watered land and green growth connect drinking to the irrigation side of the same cycle.
Precedence supplies the prior input from which the later yield develops.
A garden screened by trees supplies the productive environment around the focus meal.
The arrival of harvest time turns prior growth into presently available food.
Nearness makes the mature return approach the eater instead of remaining remote.

structural_cues: Garden, near harvest, and the eating command form an uninterrupted three-ayah sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tree-covered garden, ripened harvest, nearness, and a focus yield branch; I infer that prior deeds function like cultivation. The live alternative is a reward scene with no claim that deeds themselves grow into fruit.

changed_reading.before: The meal is a provision transferred from an account.
changed_reading.after: The meal is a matured return: what was placed earlier has grown, reached harvest, and moved within reach of the eater.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wholesome ease becomes a safety profile rather than a flavor note. The opposing sequence supplies heat entering the belly, blazing fire, encounter with burning, a hot-water branch, and cleansing matter inverted into food; the focus meal is free of burning, obstruction, and corrupt residue.

activation_trace.role: The image of water that is drinkable yet unpleasant supplies the near alternative that wholesome ease excludes.
Easy wholesome benefit makes harmless reception the defining quality of the focus intake.
Heat penetrating the belly supplies an internal anti-image to harmless assimilation.
Blazing fire and severe heat provide the external source of the corrupted bodily state.
Encountering fire and its heat makes harmful contact the opposite of wholesome intake.
Hot water places a branch-level anti-drink inside the verse's missing-intimate image.
Cleansing by flowing water becomes inverted into food, supplying corrupt residue rather than removal of residue.

structural_cues: After the left-hand account, the sequence moves through binding, fire, bodily insertion, loss of intimacy, and corrupted food, repeatedly placing harm near routes of intake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies penetrating heat, burning, hot water, cleansing residue turned into food, and the focus wholesome-benefit branch; I infer that wholesome specifies freedom from harmful aftereffects. A live alternative is that the context branches remain separate punishment images and do not define the focus modifier.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome means that the feast is agreeable and pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome means that intake remains beneficial through the whole bodily passage, without burning, coercion, or corrupt residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The causal history of one's own food is socially recursive. Failure to urge feeding the poor is followed by denied and inverted food, while the focus grants wholesome provision; how food was circulated toward vulnerable others returns as the eater's own food condition.

activation_trace.role: An allotted edible provision is the favorable side of the returning food relation.
Giving and maintenance keeps the focus meal connected to provision offered beyond the self.
Priorness places the social food relation among the acts that can return later.
Urging toward an act makes food provision a mobilized social obligation, not private sentiment.
Feeding another or seeking food identifies the specific social transfer that was withheld.
Destitution supplies the vulnerable recipient whose food relation tests the prior life.
Cleansing by flowing water becomes inverted into food, marking a corrupted provision cycle.
The consumable-share image shows that the punitive eater also receives an allotted provision, but of the opposite quality.
Sin and offense identify the conduct class to which the inverted food is assigned.

structural_cues: The left-hand account moves directly from failed encouragement of feeding to absence of wholesome food and then repeats the focus eating root with a punitive object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failure to urge feeding, poverty, corrupted food, and a contrasting eating assignment; I infer that food circulation is one component of what was advanced and returned. A live alternative is that feeding is one example among many deeds and not the exclusive cause of the focus feast.

changed_reading.before: The feast rewards an individual's stock of prior good deeds.
changed_reading.after: The eater's final provision recursively reflects how food was or was not moved toward vulnerable people in the prior days.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus imperatives preserve bodily subjecthood: recipients act on provision by eating and drinking. The opposing sequence captures, binds, and inserts the person, turning the body into material acted upon. Reward therefore includes agency over intake, not food alone.

activation_trace.role: Literal eating casts the recipient as the agent who acts on matter.
Literal drinking extends that agency to controlled bodily intake.
Capture and imprisonment reverse agency by making the person the seized object.
A collar binding an organ converts the body from consumer into constrained material.
Inserting one thing into another makes the person undergo the same directional relation that food normally undergoes.

structural_cues: Active plural imperatives in the focus contrast with singular object suffixes in the commands to seize, bind, and insert.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite grammatical roles and branches of capture, binding, and insertion; I infer that subjecthood over bodily intake is itself part of the reward. A live alternative is that the grammar simply reports two outcomes without foregrounding agency as a theme.

changed_reading.before: The contrast concerns pleasant food versus punishment.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also concerns bodily directionality: one person freely puts provision into the body, while the other body is seized and put into a constraining medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: The loan image in the focus is prevented from becoming ordinary commerce. On the unfavorable side the account remains, but conventional wealth cannot suffice and authority perishes; only what was actually advanced in prior days can return as final provision.

activation_trace.role: The loan image supplies an economic analogy whose currency the context then restricts.
The consumable share is the non-fungible return produced by the valid advance.
Counting and account remain the decisive settlement system on the unfavorable side.
Sufficiency supplies the capacity that ordinary assets explicitly fail to provide.
Possessing and multiplying wealth identifies the conventional currency that proves useless.
Falling into loss and disappearance removes the person's former means from the settlement.
Power and authority identify a second worldly asset that cannot survive into the account.

structural_cues: The left-hand sequence moves from not knowing the account to the failure of wealth and disappearance of authority before bodily punishment begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, failed sufficiency, wealth, loss, and vanished authority; I infer that the focus advance is non-fungible and cannot be replaced by accumulated assets. A live alternative is that the verses condemn one person's failed assets without defining the currency of the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The loan image can sound like an ordinary credit balance payable from whatever wealth one holds.
changed_reading.after: The only effective advance is prior action itself; money and authority are non-convertible and cannot become the final edible share.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping from the eating root to a totality branch, while the surface verb still ordinarily denotes eating. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and its wholesome modifier; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant resonance of completeness, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The eating imperative read through its supplied non-dominant split-root inventory.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness make the permitted reception sound unrestricted and without remainder.
Easy wholesome benefit contains the completeness as safe reception rather than excess.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are simply permitted to eat.
changed_reading.after: The permission faintly resonates as complete, unreserved reception of the provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context surface denotes the left side, while the retained branch names cold wine or a drink that covers the mind. It remains anchored in the focus drinking and understanding branches; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-distant cognitive anti-drink, never as a gloss of the left hand.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wholesome drinking imperative read as inward absorption that does not damage understanding.

activation_trace.role: Absorbing as understanding lets drinking describe clear cognitive intake as well as liquid intake.
Easy wholesome benefit keeps that cognitive absorption clear and unharmed.
Cold wine or mind-covering drink supplies a form-distant opposite to wholesome cognitive absorption.

changed_reading.before: The favorable and unfavorable recipients differ only in handedness and outcome.
changed_reading.after: The left-side branch faintly introduces a mind-covering anti-drink, while the focus drink can be carried as clear, wholesome absorption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the smooth drinking branch belongs to the context word for chain, whose local sense is plainly punitive. It remains anchored in the focus drinking and permeation branches and in the context's explicit insertion grammar; downstream prose should render it as a material reversal between two kinds of passage, not as a claim that the chain means drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The drinking imperative and its image of liquid permeating the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Permeation makes wholesome liquid the thing that passes smoothly into the person.
Wholesome ease distinguishes beneficial passage from coercive insertion.
Smoothness in flowing and drinking creates the branch-distant anti-image inside the chain scene.
Insertion of one thing into another reverses the direction of wholesome intake by making the person the inserted object.

changed_reading.before: Drinking and chaining are unrelated reward and punishment details.
changed_reading.after: They form an exploratory passage reversal: wholesome liquid enters the free person, whereas the constrained person is forcibly entered into a linked medium.

strongest_changes: The meal became the embodied close of a written, favorably handed, and counted account.
The garden and near harvest changed repayment into a grown return that approaches the eater.
The punishment sequence changed wholesome from pleasant flavor into safety across the whole route of intake.
The failed feeding of the poor and punitive food made one's final provision recursively social.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah joined account, harvest, bodily safety, social circulation, and agency mechanisms without forcing them into one reading; split and branch-distant cues also exposed carefully contained resonances of totality, cognitive drink, and reversed passage.
remaining_uncertainties: The loan branch supports settlement language, but the failure of wealth shows that this is not ordinary fungible commerce.
The social-feeding sequence may identify one decisive component of prior action rather than exhaust the causal phrase.
The split-root and branch-distant outliers should remain qualified resonances rather than surface-level lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Prior action as an advance yielding consequence-free benefit.** **س ل ف B001** (precedence and priorness) links past acts to **ه ن ء B001** (easy wholesome benefit without bad aftereffect). The packet supplies the causal `بما`, past days, and present consumption; I infer that what was sent ahead returns as provision without liability. Eating and drinking read as realized return on prior moral action, not mere sensory abundance.
2. **Days that have passed and emptied out.** **خ ل و B003** (passing of time and departure of a generation) is the primary temporal image, while **خ ل و B001** (being bare or empty) is reactivated by the irreversible account. The packet supplies vanished days and a fixed record; I infer that time itself is empty of opportunity even while its acts remain present in the book. The ayah contrasts unavailable time with enduring consequence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:25's immediate mirror reverses wholesome consumption into wished-for nonreceipt, sharpening the outcome as differentiated recompense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Food and drink are an allotted provision, not bare appetite.** `ء ك ل` B003 is "consumable share or provision" alongside B001 ingestion; `ش ر ب` B002 is an "allotted share of water" alongside B001 drinking. The causal `بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ` ties both imperatives to prior action, while 69:19-20 has supplied record and account. The share-branches assign food and drink the role of adjudicated allotments. The packet gives account, command, and causal basis; I infer that reckoning authorizes the portion. The line reads as receipt of a due provision as well as unrestricted enjoyment.
2. **What was advanced returns as effortless benefit.** `ه ن ء` B001 is "easy wholesome benefit" and B002 is "giving and maintenance"; `س ل ف` B001 is precedence, while B005 is "advanced money or loan." The garden and fruit supply the returned benefit, and `بِمَا` explicitly connects it to what came before. B005 gives prior deeds the role of an advance; `ه ن ء` gives their return the form of sustaining benefit without harm. The packet supplies temporal precedence and present provision; I infer advance -> returned maintenance, not a literal commercial contract. The ayah reads as past action deposited into a future economy of ease.
3. **Elapsed days are empty of presence but not of consequence.** `خ ل و` B003 is "passing away or elapsing," while B001 is "being bare or empty." The days are gone, yet what was done in them is present as food, drink, and satisfaction; 69:28-29 will show wealth and authority likewise emptied from the other recipient. B003 assigns temporal distance and B001 loss of present occupancy. The packet supplies vanished time with surviving yield; I infer that elapsed containers can be empty while their causal products persist. `ٱلْخَالِيَةِ` thus marks pastness without causal erasure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:34's failure to urge feeding and 69:36-37's corrupt food retrospectively socialize these imperatives. `ء ك ل` B003 and `ش ر ب` B002 are not merely private rewards; they are due shares within an economy where relation to others' provision matters. The later sequence makes `س ل ف` B005's advance mechanism reciprocal and ethical, not a mechanical purchase of pleasure.

baseline.text: Geçmiş günlerde yaptıklarınız karşılığında afiyetle yiyin ve için.

findings.text: Yiyecek ve içecek, çıplak iştah nesneleri değil, hesapla belirlenmiş hak edilmiş paylardır; sonraki yoksul ve bozuk yiyecek sahneleri bu payı toplumsal bir düzene yerleştirir.
Önceden gönderilen eylemler, zarar doğurmayan kolay bir yarar ve sürekli bakım olarak sahibine geri dönen bir avans gibi işler.
Geçmiş günler artık fırsat bakımından boşalmıştır; buna rağmen içlerinde yapılanların sonucu kitapta ve rızıkta varlığını sürdürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Accounting becomes settlement of rights and wealth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Calculation issues in a binding settlement involving debt, obligation, property, authority, and the sufficiency or failure of accumulated means.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Decree, registration, debt, and completed payment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A right is entered, adjudicated, and discharged through an enforceable record.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: إثبات يوجب حكما أو قدرا (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); إدخال الاسم في سجل أو زمرة (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`); مكاتبة العبد على عتقه (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`); العد والحساب (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); الحسبة والنظر في الأمر (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); الحكم والأمر القاطع (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); الإبلاغ والوصية القاطعة (`quranic:root_001237:B002/m01`); إحكام الصنع وإنفاذ الفعل (`quranic:root_001237:B005/m01`); أداء الحق واستيفاؤه (`quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`); المال المقدم (`quranic:root_000733:B005/m01`); الإتاوة المؤداة (`quranic:root_000009:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The document fixes judgment, enrolls a name, or schedules emancipation payments. Counting and public oversight support adjudication; notification, crafted decree, debt settlement, an advance, and tribute complete the legal-economic circuit from entry to discharge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Capital, income, and the limit of sufficiency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Property is acquired and produces income, yet is tested by whether it actually suffices or substitutes for the person.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: اتخاذ المال وكثرته (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); الغنى والاستغناء (`quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`); الغَناء والكفاية (`quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`); الغنى بالمكان (`quranic:root_001110:B004/m01`); الكفاية والإغناء (`quranic:root_000318:B003/m01`); الحسب والمآثر (`quranic:root_000318:B004/m01`); دخل يخرج من أصل ثابت (`quranic:root_001102:B011/m01`); استهلاك المال وأخذه (`quranic:root_000043:B004/m01`); رزق ومعاش وحسن حال (`quranic:root_000934:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Accumulated wealth, independence, adequacy, settled estates, inherited reputation, and property income define resources that appear durable. Consumption or seizure of others' property and provision as a source of livelihood test the moral quality of that wealth; the decisive question is whether any of it can stand in for the owner.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Emancipation contract and paid right provide a legal template; intermarried in-laws, the self-sufficient married woman, marriage as protection from need, reunited household, and mutual satisfaction provide the social result. Settlement is therefore also the making or unmaking of durable relations.

pericope.label: Books of deeds and contrasting destinies

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeme eylemini merkeze alırken yiyeceği, bir kerelik yeme veya lokmayı, çok yiyeni, birlikte yiyeni ve başkasını doyuranı da aynı anlam çevresinde toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı rolleri doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçek yeme çevresiyle sınırlıdır; ürün, mal, dedikodu ve başka benzetmeli kullanımlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış mal, ateş veya söz kullanımları bu kapsama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Besini ağız yoluyla tüketme eylemi ve bu eylemin doğrudan çevresindeki yiyecek, tek yeme, çok yiyen kişi, birlikte yiyen kişi ve başkasını doyuran kişi rolleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yiyeceği tüketme eylemidir.
Yenen şey, bir yeme keresi veya tek lokma da aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.
Çok yiyen, birlikte yiyen ve başkasını doyuran kişiler eyleme katılım biçimlerine göre adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, yeme eylemini temel alır ve yiyecek, tek lokma ya da yeme, çok yiyen, yemeğe eşlik eden ve doyuran kişi adlarını bu temel etrafında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: yeme, yiyecek ve yeme rolleri
concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem ile ona doğrudan bağlı nesne, kerelik ve kişi rollerinin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeme çekirdeğini, yiyeceği, tek kereliği ve katılımcı rollerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin besini tüketmesi anlatıldığında doğal eylem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Besini tüketme eylemini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimseyle aynı öğünde birlikte yiyen kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte yeme ilişkisini ve kişi rolünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir öğünlük yeme veya tek lokma

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kullanıp bitirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Besin dışındaki her türlü nesnenin harcanması veya yok edilmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yemeye özgü çekirdeği genel tüketimle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yiyecek, tek yeme, çok yiyen, birlikte yiyen ve doyuran rollerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yiyeceği ağızla alma ve lokma oluşturma hareketine daha dar biçimde odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yiyeceğin ağız yoluyla alınmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yeme eyleminin çevresindeki nesne ve kişi rollerini genişçe kapsarken komşu dal ağıza lokma alma hareketi ve lokma birimiyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yakın karışma lokmalama dalıyla görüldü, diğerleri öğün, yiyecek türü veya ayrı benzetmeli kullanımlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الأكل، الطعام، اللقمة والمرة، كثرة الأكل، المؤاكل، الإطعام والمؤكل، وما يؤكل عموما.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أخذ المال أو الغيبة أو الثمر إذا قصد به الغلة لا فعل الأكل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأكل معروف؛ أكلت الطعام أكلا ومأكلا؛ الأكل تناول المطعم؛ الأكلة المرة واللقمة؛ رجل أكول كثير الأكل؛ أكيلك الذي يؤاكلك؛ المؤكل المطعم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ağaç, hurmalık, bahçe ve ekinin verdiği meyve ya da ürünü açıkça adlandırır. Dal çerçevesi bunu yeme eyleminden ayırarak doğru bir ürün ve verim anlamı olarak sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada söz konusu olan bitkinin verdiği ürün veya verimdir; ürünü yeme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ürün anlamı tanımlanır ve belirli bir yeme kalıbına ya da genel geçimlik anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Ağaç, hurmalık, bahçe veya ekinin verdiği yenebilir ürün, meyve ya da verimdir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir bitkinin verdiği meyve veya üründür.
Anlam tek ağaçtan bahçe ve ekinin genel verimine kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağaçların, hurmalıkların, bahçelerin ve ekinlerin verdiği meyveyi veya ürünü aynı yalın anlamda birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: ağaç ve ekin ürünü
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bitkinin, bahçenin veya ekinin verdiği meyve ve verim topluca kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel kaynağı ve elde edilen ürün ya da verim sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir ağaç veya meyve veren bitkinin ürünü anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin verdiği yenebilir ürün anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bahçe veya ekinin sürekli ya da toplu ürünü vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürün verme sonucunu ve toplu kapsamı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ürünün bitkinin veya bahçenin verimi oluşunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal meyvenin çıkması, olgunlaşması ve meyveli ağaç gibi daha geniş meyve çevresini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ağaçların verdiği meyveyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağaç ve ekinin verdiği ürün ya da verim değerindedir; komşu dal ise meyvenin kendisini, oluşumunu ve olgunlaşmasını daha geniş biçimde anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; meyve dalı doğrudan örtüşme taşır, öteki adaylar büyüme, hasat, verimli toprak veya ürünün azalması gibi ayrı süreçlerdir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكل الشجرة والنخل والزرع بمعنى الثمر والغلة وما تؤتيه الأرض.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه فعل تناول الطعام ولا الرزق المجازي العام إلا إذا نص على الثمر أو الغلة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أكل الشجرة ثمرها؛ الأكل ثمر النخل والشجر؛ أكل بستانك دائم وأكله ثمره؛ والأكل لما يؤكل قال تعالى أكلها دائم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin dünyadan aldığı payı, geniş geçimliği, kendisine hesap sorulmadan ayrılan şeyi ve yöneticilerin verdiği tahsisatı birlikte gösterir. Dalın pay ve geçimlik çerçevesi bu ortak verilen pay çekirdeğini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, kişiye düşen veya verilen payla sınırlıdır; haksız mal alma ve gerçek yeme eylemi buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın pay ve geçimlik anlamı tanımlanır; mal tüketme kalıbı veya yalnızca besin miktarı bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye dünyadan düşen veya kendisine verilen pay, geçimlik ya da tahsisattır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kişinin elde ettiği pay ve geçimliktir.
Pay, hesap sorulmadan ayrılan bir geçimlik veya yönetici tarafından verilen tahsisat olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişinin dünyadaki payını ve geçimliğini, ayrıca kendisine ayrılan ya da yönetici tarafından verilen tahsisatı ortak bir pay anlamında toplar.

concept_gloss.text: verilen pay ve geçimlik
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiye düşen dünya payı, geniş geçimlik veya kendisine ayrılmış tahsisat birlikte kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Pay olma niteliğini, verilme ilişkisini ve geçimlik kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin yaşamını sürdürmesine yarayan dünya payı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye düşen pay ve geçim sağlama işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi için hesap dışı bırakılan veya yönetici tarafından verilen payda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli kişiye ayrılma ve verilme koşulunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dünya payı ve geniş geçimliği olan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, payı geçimlik veya bir yetkilinin verdiği tahsisat olarak somutlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, payın yanında genel talih ve nasip değerlendirmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir kişiye düşen payı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal verilen ya da elde edilen geçim payına yönelir; komşu dal ise maddi tahsisatla sınırlı olmayan genel nasip ve talih alanını da içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel pay ve nasip dalı en yakın karşılıktır, kalanlar yeterlik, besin gereksinimi, aile geçindirme veya belirli bir yiyecek türüyle sınırlıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحظ والرزق والطعمات والمآكل والآكال وما يجعل للإنسان أو تعطيه الملوك.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mal kalıbında harcamayı ve özellikle hakka aykırı sarfı, kişi kalıbında ise başkalarının malını alıp onları sömürmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi bu iki yapı bağımlı kullanımı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnızca malı harcama, ele geçirme veya sömürme bildiren kalıplarda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen mal ve kişileri sömürme kalıplarına bağlıdır; yalın köke genel bir tüketme anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda malı harcama veya hakka aykırı yere sarf etme; kişilere yöneldiğinde ise onların malını alarak kendilerini sömürmedir.

facets.statement: Mal kalıbında temel anlam, malı harcamak veya bir amaç uğruna tüketmektir.
Hakka aykırılık belirtildiğinde mal, doğru olmayan bir yere sarf edilir.
Kişi topluluğuna yönelen yapıda onların malını almak ve onları sömürmek anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, malı harcama veya hakka aykırı biçimde sarf etme ile insanların malını alıp onları sömürme kullanımlarını kalıba bağlı olarak ayırır.

concept_gloss.text: malı harcama veya ele geçirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Malın sarf edilmesini ya da bir topluluğun malının alınarak sömürülmesini bildiren belirtilmiş kalıplarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Harcama ve ele geçirme seçeneklerini, mal nesnesini ve kalıp sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Malın hakka aykırı bir yere sarf edilmesi açıkça belirtildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Malı sarf etme eylemini ve hakka aykırılık koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya topluluğun malını alarak onlardan yararlanma anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mal alma ve kişileri sömürme bileşenlerini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: malı harcamak veya tüketerek elden çıkarmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal malı harcamayı ve başkalarını malları üzerinden sömürmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal birinin malını bütünüyle soyup alma eylemine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da malın sahibinin elinden çıkması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal harcama ile sömürücü almayı kalıba göre kapsar; komşu dal ise doğrudan soyma ve malı bütünüyle ele geçirme çekirdeğine sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; soyup alma dalı en yararlı sınırı verir, diğerleri gizli hıyanet, savurganlık, borç ödeme, kandırma veya hırsızlık gibi ayrı koşullar taşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكل الأموال، إنفاق المال، أخذ أموال الضعفاء، واستغلال القوم أو أموالهم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الرزق المباح أو الطعمة المعطاة إلا بقرينة أخذ المال أو صرفه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin odunu yakıp tüketmesini, ateşe odun verilmesini, alevin şiddetlenmesini ve buna benzetilen öfke ile kılıç parıltısını destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki hoş koku, sürme ve gümüş örnekleri dal iddiasında bulunmadığından tanımdan çıkarılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ateşin tüketmesi, beslenmesi ve harlanması ile açıkça verilen öfke ve kılıç benzetmeleriyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ateşin şiddetlenmesini bildiren türemiş biçim ile ateş, öfke ve kılıç kalıpları ayrı tutulur; biri diğerine yalın anlam olarak yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin odunu yakıp tüketmesi, ateşe yakıt verilmesi veya alevin şiddetlenmesidir; aynı harlanma görüntüsü öfkenin kabarması ve kılıcın keskin parıltısı için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Ateş odunu yakarak tüketir.
Ateşe odun vermek, onu yakıtla beslemek olarak anlatılır.
Alevin şiddetlenmesi, ateşin kendi içinde büyüyüp harlanmasıdır.
Harlanma görüntüsü şiddetli öfkeye ve keskin kılıcın parıltısına aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ateşin odunu tüketmesi, ateşe odun verilmesi ve alevin şiddetlenmesi üzerinde birleşir; aynı görüntü öfkenin kabarmasına ve kılıcın keskin parıltısına taşınır.

concept_gloss.text: ateşin tüketmesi, beslenmesi ve harlanması
concept_gloss.applicability: Ateşin odunu yakması, ateşe yakıt verilmesi, alevin şiddetlenmesi ve açıkça belirtilmiş benzetmeli uzantılar birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tüketme, yakıt verme, şiddetlenme ve benzetmeli harlanma ayrımlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ateşin odunu yakarak ortadan kaldırdığı gerçek yanma bağlamında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin ateşe odun vererek yanmayı sürdürmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakıt veren kişiyi, ateşi ve odun aracını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin öfkesinin çok şiddetlenmesi ateş görüntüsüyle anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öfkenin şiddetlenmesini ve harlanma benzetmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ateşin odunu tüketmesini, kendi kendine harlanmasını ve öfke ile kılıç uzantılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle odun ekleyerek ateşi güçlendirme ve bununla bir şeyi yakma eylemine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ateşe odun verilmesini ve yanmanın güçlenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem ateşin tüketici etkisini hem harlanma görüntüsünün uzantılarını taşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise ateşi odunla güçlendiren dış eylemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ateşi odunla güçlendirme en yakın sınırdır, öteki ateş dalları yalnız alev, yakma, kaynama veya köz karıştırma aşamalarına odaklanır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكل النار للحطب، إطعام النار، ائتكلت النار، وتوهج الغضب أو السيف أو الطيب والكحل والفضة على صورة الاشتعال.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kaşıntıyı, bir şeyin aşınıp bozulmasını, diş çürümesini ve derideki ince kusurlu yeri destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki gebe devenin yavru tüyünden rahatsız olması yalnız ayrı sözcük birimi kanıtında bulunur ve dal iddiasını genişletemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kaşıntı, aşınma, bozulma, diş çürümesi ve derideki incelmiş kusurla sınırlıdır; ateş gibi parlamayı içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel aşınıp bozulma biçimleri ile diş ve deri kalıpları ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur; özel kalıplar yalın anlamı belirlemez.

concept_map.definition: Bedende kaşıntı; nesnede aşınıp bozulma; dişlerde çürüme ya da aşınma ve deride işlenince ortaya çıkan ince, kusurlu yerdir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin aşınarak bozulması veya bir bölümünü yitirmesi temel süreçtir.
Bedende ve başta kaşıntı biçiminde ortaya çıkabilir.
Dişlerde çürüme veya aşınma olarak görülür.
Deride dıştan sağlam görünen, işlenince kusuru beliren ince bir yer olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aşınıp bozulma çekirdeğini kaşıntı, diş aşınması ve işlenince kusuru beliren ince deri yeri gibi özel görünümlerle birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.text: aşınma, bozulma ve kaşıntı
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel maddi bozulma ile beden, diş ve deri üzerindeki özel görünümler birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Aşınma çekirdeğini, bozulma sonucunu ve kaşıntı görünümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin zamanla aşınıp bir bölümünü yitirmesi veya çürümesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Süreç olarak aşınmayı ve sonuç olarak bozulmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişlerde çürüme veya doku kaybı bulunduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Diş alanını ve aşınma sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal diş dışında genel aşınma, beden kaşıntısı ve ince deri kusurunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız dişlerdeki oyuk, çürüme ve birikinti görünümlerine yoğunlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal dişlerdeki aşınma ve bozulmayı ortaklaşa kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın diş aşınması yalnız özel bir yüzeyidir; komşu dal diş çürümesini kendi çekirdeği yapar ve diş kökü ile yüzeyindeki birikintileri de kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; diş çürümesi dalı doğrudan örtüşür, diğerleri genel bozulma, deri hastalığı, yaralanma veya belirli bir dökülme türüdür.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التآكل والفساد والحكاك وأكال الرأس والجسد، أكل الأسنان، رقة الأديم، وأذى الناقة من وبر جنينها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yırtıcının avını ve yenmek için ayrılıp beslenen koyun ya da küçükbaş hayvanı destekler. Geçici çerçeveye eklenen yenmek için ayrılmış hurma ağacı yalnız ayrı sözcük birimi kanıtında yer aldığından dal tanımına alınamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yırtıcı tarafından avlanan canlıyla yenmek üzere ayrılmış küçükbaş hayvanı kapsar; genel yiyecek ve hurma ağacı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal av olmuş veya yenmek üzere ayrılmış canlıyı tanımlar; özel ağaç birimi bu genel tanıma aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yırtıcı tarafından avlanıp yenmiş ya da yenmek üzere ayrılıp beslenmiş canlı hayvandır.

facets.statement: Bir yırtıcının yakalayıp yediği canlı, onun avı olarak adlandırılır.
Koyun veya küçükbaş hayvan, üretim ya da satış yerine yenmek için ayrılıp beslenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yırtıcının avı olan hayvan ile soy veya satış için değil, yenmek üzere ayrılıp beslenen koyunu yenilme hedefinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: av olmuş veya yenmek için ayrılmış hayvan
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir hayvanın yırtıcı avı olması ya da insan tüketimi için ayrılıp beslenmesi birlikte kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanı, yenilme hedefini ve av olma ile hazırlanma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir koyun veya başka hayvanın yırtıcı tarafından yakalanıp yenmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Avı, yırtıcıyla ilişkisini ve yenilme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koyunun üreme veya satış için değil, yenmek üzere ayrılıp beslenmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yırtıcı hayvanın kendisini, türlerini ve avlanma davranışını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı avlanma olayında yırtıcı ile av ilişkisini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olayın yenilen hayvan tarafındadır; komşu dal ise saldıran yırtıcıyı ve onun avlanma eylemini merkeze alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yırtıcı dalı katılımcı karşıtlığını açıklar, diğerleri hayvan türü, pişirme, avcı canlı veya başka bir ölüm nedenidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكيل الذئب وأكيلة الأسد والسبع، والأكولة من الغنم أو الشاة التي تعزل أو تسمن للأكل أو يستثنى أخذها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kimsenin başkalarını arkalarından kötülemesini, onların saygınlığını zedelemesini ve bunu insan eti yeme görüntüsüyle anlatmayı açıkça destekler. Dal çerçevesi bu söz eylemini doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal doğrudan arkadan çekiştirmedir; söz taşıyarak kişiler arasını bozma ayrıca belirtilmedikçe buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız saygınlığa saldırma ve insan eti yeme görüntüsünü taşıyan verilen kalıplarda geçerlidir; yalın köke yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi arkasından kötüleyip saygınlığını zedelemek, bunu onun etini yemek görüntüsüyle anlatmaktır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek eylem, başkasını arkasından kötülemektir.
Eylem, kişinin saygınlığını veya etini tüketme görüntüsüyle ifade edilir.
Bu davranışı alışkanlık hâline getiren kişi de aynı kalıpla nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanları arkalarından kötülemeyi, onların saygınlığına veya etine saldırma görüntüsüyle anlatır ve bunu alışkanlık edinen kişiyi ayrıca niteler.

concept_gloss.text: arkadan çekiştirip saygınlığı zedeleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin yokluğunda kötülenmesi ve saygınlığının sözle aşındırılması verilen kalıp içinde anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arkadan kötüleme eylemini, hedef kişiyi ve saygınlık zararını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi yokken onun kötü yanlarını söyleyerek kendisini küçültme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hedefin yokluğunu ve kötüleyici söz eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Arkadan kötülemenin yeme görüntüsü özellikle korunmak istendiğinde açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Saygınlık zararını ve tüketme benzetmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişiler arasında söz taşıyıp onları birbirine düşürerek ilişkiyi bozar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zarar verici söz söyleme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sonucu hedef kişinin saygınlığının zedelenmesidir; komşu dalın kurucu sonucu ise söz taşınan kişiler arasındaki ilişkinin bozulmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; iç komşu söz taşıma dalı gerçek anlam karşıtlığını verir, dış adayların çoğu yalnız beden bölümlerine ilişkin biçim benzerlikleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكل العرض، الغيبة، أكل لحوم الناس، وذو أكلة أو إكلة في الناس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النميمة بين القوم إلا إذا كان اللفظ على أكل اللحم أو الغيبة نفسها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiler arasında söz taşıyarak kışkırtmayı, aralarını bozmayı ve bunu yapan kişiyi açıkça adlandırır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu ilişki bozucu söz eylemini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birden çok kişi arasında söz taşıma ve ilişkiyi bozma kurucudur; tek kişiyi arkadan kötüleme tek başına yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kişiler arasını bozmayı bildiren verilen kalıplara bağlıdır; genel konuşma veya yalın yeme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kişiler arasında söz taşıyıp onları birbirine karşı kışkırtarak aralarındaki ilişkiyi bozmaktır; bunu yapan kişi de aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Kişiler arasında söz taşıyarak aralarını bozmak çekirdek eylemdir.
Eylem, tarafları birbirine karşı kışkırtmayı içerir.
Bu işi yapan söz taşıyıcı kişi de aynı yapı içinde adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlar arasında söz taşıma, kışkırtma ve ilişkiyi bozma eylemlerini birleştirir; bu işi yapan kişi ayrıca adlandırılır.

concept_gloss.text: söz taşıyarak arayı bozma

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
